descriptions.chronicle: Your journey leaves its mark here.

guide.hearth: I’m Zharomir. Touch the glowing hearth. Oaths take shape here.
guide.seals: These glowing seals hold your commitments.
guide.chronicle: The chronicle holds the traces of your journey. Touch the book.
guide.door: The moonlit door leads to the menu. I explain the Forge rules in the Tutorial.

tutorial.intro: I will tell you how the Forge works. Touch the place you want to hear about.
tutorial.again: Touch another place or close our talk.
tutorial.end: That is everything the Forge follows today. The Tutorial waits in the menu whenever you want to return.

hearth.1: At the hearth you choose a workout: running, strength training or mobility.
hearth.2: You set the start, now or at a chosen time, and a later completion deadline.
hearth.3: Before you make the Oath, you see all its rules. Only your explicit acceptance creates it.
hearth.4: Once made, its rules never change, not even by the Forge. A different promise is a new Oath.

seals.1: The seals are your current Oaths: scheduled, active and those awaiting review.
seals.2: Each Oath keeps its times in its own timezone. Changing your phone’s timezone does not move them.
seals.3: The Forge decides the state, not your phone’s clock. When the last deadline in its rules passes, the Oath awaits review. That is not a miss.

chronicle.1: The chronicle keeps finished Oaths together with their outcome.
chronicle.2: Nobody rewrites the chronicle. Each Oath keeps the rules accepted when it was made.

door.1: The door leads to the menu. There you can switch character or create a new one, up to three.
door.2: Each character has its own Oaths, chronicle and pause.
door.3: You can pause in Settings. It withdraws this character’s scheduled and active Oaths. Those under review keep waiting.
door.4: While paused you cannot make a new Oath. Resuming lifts the pause but does not restore withdrawn Oaths.

active.0: The Oath is under way. Once the workout is done, submit your proof.
active.1: Time is on your side. Pick a time and place that suit you.
active.2: The fire burns steady. Workout first, then proof, at your own pace.
active.3: There is still time before the deadline. It helps to know when you will set out.
active.4: After the workout, come back here with your proof. I will wait by the seal.

activeSoon.0: Under an hour to the deadline. This is a good moment to set out.
activeSoon.1: Under an hour left. If the workout is behind you, submit your proof.
activeSoon.2: The fire is burning low, the deadline is close. Set out as soon as you can.
activeSoon.3: The deadline is close, under an hour left. Workout now, proof right after.

cutoff.0: The proof window is still open. Submit it if the workout ended by the deadline.
cutoff.1: Workout finished by the deadline? The proof window is still open.
cutoff.2: The candle is still burning. If the workout ended by the deadline, submit your proof now.

interrupted.0: That is not your fault. The proof copy is waiting, send it again.

assessing.0: Your proof has arrived. Now we wait for the assessment together.
assessing.1: The proof is in the Forge now. The result will appear here.
assessing.2: Proof submitted, that was an important step. You can rest now.
assessing.3: The fire has done its part, now comes the assessment. Nothing more is needed for now.
assessing.4: Proof received. The rest is now up to the assessment.

review.0: This Oath is under review, and that is not a miss.

fulfilled.0: Oath fulfilled. This workout stays on your path.
fulfilled.1: Word kept, the workout is in the chronicle. Another Oath whenever you like.
fulfilled.2: The fire has taken this workout. Good, steady work.
fulfilled.3: A fulfilled Oath is another step on the trail. Rest before you go on.
fulfilled.4: This workout counts. The hearth is ready for the next Oath.

missed.0: The hearth is ready for a new Oath. We set out whenever you want.
missed.1: Your earlier marks stay in the chronicle. When you want, we can forge a new Oath.
missed.2: The next Oath can be smaller and closer to your day. The hearth will wait.

unresolved.0: This could not be decided, and that is not a miss.
unresolved.1: Having no outcome is not a failure. The hearth is waiting for another Oath whenever you like.

withdrawn.0: This Oath ended with the pause. A new one can begin whenever you like.
withdrawn.1: The pause was your choice. The hearth is waiting for a new Oath.
withdrawn.2: Good to have you back. We can forge a new Oath when you want.

confirmed.0: The Oath is made and already under way. Think about when and where you will train.
confirmed.1: Your word is forged. Now the workout, at your own pace, then the proof.
confirmed.2: The seal is set. Pick a time and place that fit your day.

confirmedScheduled.0: The Oath is made and its start is set. Until then, you can get ready calmly.
confirmedScheduled.1: Your word is forged and waits for its start. It helps to know where you will train then.

proofScreen.0: Three steps: type, image and confirmation. We will take them in order.
proofScreen.1: Choose the type, add an image, confirm. The Forge does the rest.
proofScreen.2: Proof is just three steps. Start with the type.
